nowPlaying.title: 求救信号
nowPlaying.summary: 一名美国海军飞行员在冷战时期执行绝密任务时不幸被困在敌营。他唯有与一位性格古怪的前克格勃特工联手才有一线生机。
nowPlaying.summaryEn: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.
